A0_A1.title: Cycling in the Park
A0_A1.visualDescription: Red bicycle parked near a green tree in a park.

pages.bio: I ride a red bicycle in the park every weekend. It is easy, cheap, and fun! I feel the cool wind. I listen to music and eat delicious ice cream at the park cafe.

A0_A1.opener: Hello! Can you ride a bicycle? Do you ride in the park?
icebreakers: No, but I want to learn!
A0_A1.prompt: Where do you like to ride a bicycle or walk? What do you see in the park?

A2.title: Sourdough Bread Baking
A2.visualDescription: Golden loaf of sourdough bread on a wooden cutting board with a knife.

pages.bio: I love baking artisanal sourdough bread at home. I mix simple flour, water, and starter, then bake it in a hot oven. My kitchen smells wonderful when the bread bakes. The warm crust crackles when it cools down, and it tastes delicious with butter!

A2.opener: Fresh sourdough bread from the oven! Do you prefer butter or olive oil?
A2.prompt: Explain the basic steps of sourdough baking using simple present tenses.

B1.title: Bouldering & Rock Climbing
B1.visualDescription: Climber wearing chalk bag, gripping indoor bouldering holds on an overhang wall.

pages.bio: Bouldering is an engaging physical hobby where climbers solve vertical routes on climbing walls using chalked hands and core strength. This sport combines tactical problem solving similar to chess with full-body functional endurance, offering a rewarding sense of achievement.
redFlags: ✗ Chalk dust on clothes and gear

B1.opener: Hey! Have you ever attempted indoor bouldering or rock climbing?
B1.prompt: Describe how rock climbing combines physical conditioning with mental focus.

B2.title: 35mm Analog Film Photography
B2.visualDescription: Vintage 35mm film camera resting on a darkroom wooden bench next to developed negatives.

pages.bio: 35mm film photography requires deliberate artistic composition and patience, restricting the photographer to 36 exposures per roll without instantaneous digital previews. Developing chemical negatives in darkrooms allows photographers to embrace grain textures, light leaks, and unedited candid human authenticity.
greenFlags: ✓ Tangible physical medium and archival prints
redFlags: ✗ Escalating chemical and film canister expenses

B2.opener: Greetings! How does the deliberate artistic constraint of analog film alter creative expression compared to digital photographic abundance?
B2.prompt: Critique the psychological and aesthetic divergences between digital smartphone photography and traditional 35mm analog film.
